h1: Korea Entry Guide from Hong Kong
metaTitle: Hong Kong to Korea: Do You Need a Visa? (2026) — Korea Trip Hub
metaDesc: Do Hong Kong (HKSAR) passport holders need a visa for South Korea? No — visa-free for up to 90 days, and K-ETA is waived through 2026. Just file the free e-Arrival Card before you land. Full entry steps inside.

verdict.headline: No tourist visa needed — Hong Kong (HKSAR) passports are visa-free.
verdict.sub: For short-term tourism you don't apply for any visa. Right now K-ETA is waived too, so the main thing to do is file the free e-Arrival Card before you land.

highlights.title: No visa, and K-ETA waived through 2026
highlights.body: Hong Kong (HKSAR) is one of the 22 countries/regions exempt from K-ETA through 31 Dec 2026, so you apply for neither a visa nor K-ETA for short tourism. The waiver is scheduled to end and K-ETA returns on 1 Jan 2027 — reconfirm before you travel.

highlights.title: You still need the e-Arrival Card
highlights.body: Almost every visitor files the free e-Arrival Card at e-arrivalcard.go.kr, within 72 hours before arrival. (Valid K-ETA holders are exempt, but with K-ETA waived you should file the e-Arrival Card.)

highlights.title: This page is for the HKSAR passport
highlights.body: It covers the Hong Kong SAR passport. If you travel on a BN(O), a Document of Identity, or another passport, check that document's own rules — they can differ.

tldr: No tourist visa and no K-ETA needed right now — Hong Kong (HKSAR) is visa-free and K-ETA-exempt through 2026.
Do file the free e-Arrival Card at e-arrivalcard.go.kr within 72 hours of arrival.
Bring a passport valid for your stay plus proof of onward/return travel.
You can stay Up to 90 days.

items.detail: Hong Kong (HKSAR) passports enter Korea visa-free for short tourism, and K-ETA is waived through 2026 — there's nothing to apply for.

items.title: File the e-Arrival Card
items.detail: Within 72 hours before arrival, complete it free at e-arrivalcard.go.kr and save the QR/confirmation.

items.title: Check passport & onward ticket
items.detail: Make sure your passport is valid for your stay, and have a return/onward ticket plus your first accommodation address.

items.title: At immigration
items.detail: Show your passport and e-Arrival confirmation; fingerprints and a photo may be taken. Keep it tourism — no paid work on visa-free entry.

items.a: No — for short-term tourism, Hong Kong SAR passport holders enter Korea visa-free. You do not apply for any tourist visa.
